titleText: JTF News: BBC News, ABC News Australia
mainText: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni stated that President Trump fabricated a story that she requested a photograph with him at the G7.
Morocco national team captain Achraf Hakimi is to stand trial on rape charges.
Lebanon reports 18 deaths from Israeli strikes; Israel reports four soldiers killed by Hezbollah.

titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, World Health Organization
mainText: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention will allocate $107 million in emergency funding for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda.
Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth stated the U.S. will review its military presence in Europe and renewed criticism of NATO.
